title: Anno 1800
shortDescription: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you.

description: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you. In Anno 1800, players will take charge of their own fortune as they navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape and malicious political arena of the 19th century in their quest to build an empire that will reach from the smog-filled cities of Europe to the teeming jungles of South America. Combining beloved features with innovative gameplay, Anno 1800 is the beginning of a new era for the Anno franchise as players leave their mark on a crucial moment in human history. topReviews.review: Downloaded the game 20 mins ago and still can't create an account with their website???
topReviews.developer_response:
Hi there Didi. I'm sorry to hear you are having an issue creating an account.

If you've only tried using the Ubisoft Connect launcher, let's instead try creating your account via the Ubisoft website. Once you're there, click on the grey person icon in the top right corner, then choose "Create an Account." From there, please follow these [url=www.ubisoft.com/help/article/000078663] dedicated steps on Ubisoft account creation [/url].

If you continue encountering issues with account creation such as the website remaining blank/constantly loading trying your credentials, or 404 errors, try all the steps in our [url=www.ubisoft.com/help/article/000062631] browser troubleshooting guide [/url]. These will cross off common causes for websites not working properly.

If you are still having issues after this, please do not hesitate to contact our support teams so that we can assist you further. To do that open a [url=https://www.ubisoft.com/en-us/help/contact] new support case [/url] and choose the following options:

Account Management and Security > Other Account Queries > Type a full detailed description and include any error messages you've seen as well as mentioning all specific troubleshooting you've already tried.

Attach a screenshot of any error messages or in general what you're seeing when trying to create an account and someone will get back to you.

whyPlay: Anno 1800 is the most polished production-chain game ever made. Watching your trade ships crisscross between Old World factories and New World plantations is hypnotic. The beauty mode alone is worth the price — you can spend hours just walking through your cities at street level. But don't let the pretty facade fool you: late-game supply chains require genuine engineering thought. It's the best game in the Anno series, full stop.
whyPlayZh: 《纪元1800》是有史以来最精致的产业链游戏。看着你的商船在旧世界工厂和新世界种植园之间穿梭，本身就是一种享受。光第一人称街景模式就值回票价——你能花几个小时在自己建的城市里散步。但别被美貌骗了：后期的供应链需要真正的工程思维。系列最佳，毫无疑问。
